about: Frame-cost budgets for `python tools/browser_gpu_bench.py --check` (docs/design/performance/README.md). Counts per frame at the seed=1 start pose, measured by tools/perf_probe.js; textureMB is GPU texture memory allocated through the context. Limits are the perf/smooth measurements plus about 15 % headroom: raise one only with a reason in the PR description.
